cloudflare:
  api_key: env:CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY
  account_id: env:CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
  # After the order 1 models: the daily Neurons go to images and transcription first.
  order: 2
  discovery_match:
    require_workers_paid: false
  exclude:
    - "*llama-guard*"
    - "*llama-3.2-11b-vision*"
  tier:
    TIER-A:
      - "*qwen3.*"
      - "*nemotron-3-120b-a12b*"
      - "@cf/openai/gpt-oss-120b"
    TIER-B:
      - "*qwen3-30b-a3b*"
      - "*deepseek-r1*"
      - "@cf/openai/gpt-oss-20b"
      - "@cf/zai-org/glm-4.7-flash"
      - "@cf/google/gemma-4-*"
      - "@cf/qwen/qwq-32b"
    TIER-C:
      - "@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-*"
      - "@cf/meta/llama-4-scout-*"
      - "@cf/mistralai/mistral-small-*"
      - "@cf/qwen/qwen2.5-coder-*"
      - "@cf/aisingapore/*"
    TIER-D:
      - "@cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-*"
      - "@cf/meta/llama-3.2-*"
      - "@cf/ibm-granite/*"
      - "@cf/swiss-ai/*"
      - "@cf/utter-project/*"
      - "*-lora"

  models:
    "@cf/qwen/qwq-32b": { max_input_tokens: 20000, max_output_tokens: 4000 }
    # The ladders of the Workers AI docs: gpt-oss takes low, medium and high, and qwen3.8 takes
    # low, medium and xhigh, wider than the coded low and medium of the block.
    "@cf/openai/gpt-oss-120b": { supported_reasoning_efforts: [low, medium, high] }
    "@cf/openai/gpt-oss-20b": { supported_reasoning_efforts: [low, medium, high] }
    "@cf/qwen/qwen3.8-27b": { supported_reasoning_efforts: [low, medium, xhigh] }
    # Image input: FLUX.2 edits with up to 4 input images, in daedalus/photos.
    "*flux-2*": { supports_vision: true }
    # Clef answers typed questions with probabilities, not chat text, although Workers AI lists it as text.
    "@cf/cloudflare/clef*": { mode: decisions }

gemini:
  api_key: env:GEMINI_API_KEY
  reasoning_effort: high
  exclude:
    - aqa
    - "*nano-banana*"
    - veo*
    - "*robotics*"
    - antigravity*
    - "*-latest"
    - gemini-2.5-*
    - gemini-3.1-pro-preview*
    - deep-research*
    - "*omni*"
    - "*-image*"
    - "*-live*"
    - lyria-*
  tier:
    TIER-A:
      - gemini-3.8-flash
      - gemini-3.7-flash
    TIER-B:
      - gemini-3.5-flash
      - gemini-3.6-flash
      - gemma-4-*
    TIER-C:
      - gemini-3.1-flash*
      - gemini-3.5-flash-lite*
      - gemini-3-flash-preview
  models:
    # The ladders of the Gemini docs: 3.7 and 3.8 flash reject MINIMAL, and the rest of the 3.x
    # flash line and the gemma-4 line name minimal to high.
    gemini-3-flash-preview: { rpm: 5, tpm: 250000 }
    gemini-3.1-flash-lite: { rpm: 15, tpm: 250000, supported_reasoning_efforts: [minimal, low, medium, high] }
    gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview: { rpm: 15, tpm: 250000, supported_reasoning_efforts: [minimal, low, medium, high] }
    gemini-3.5-flash: { rpm: 5, tpm: 250000, supported_reasoning_efforts: [minimal, low, medium, high] }
    gemini-3.5-flash-lite: { rpm: 15, tpm: 250000, supported_reasoning_efforts: [minimal, low, medium, high] }
    gemini-3.6-flash: { rpm: 5, tpm: 250000, supported_reasoning_efforts: [minimal, low, medium, high] }
    gemini-3.7-flash: { rpm: 5, tpm: 250000, supported_reasoning_efforts: [low, medium, high] }
    gemini-3.8-flash: { rpm: 5, tpm: 250000, supported_reasoning_efforts: [low, medium, high] }
    gemma-4-26b-a4b-it: { rpm: 30, tpm: 16000, supported_reasoning_efforts: [minimal, low, medium, high] }
    gemma-4-31b-it: { rpm: 30, tpm: 16000, supported_reasoning_efforts: [minimal, low, medium, high] }
    "gemini-3*-tts*": { mode: audio_speech, rpm: 3, tpm: 10000 }
    "gemini-3*-transcribe": { mode: audio_transcription, rpm: 3, tpm: 10000 }

groq:
  api_key: env:GROQ_API_KEY
  # The free limits of https://console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits
  rpm: 30
  tpm: 8000
  exclude:
    - "*prompt-guard*"
    - "*safeguard*"
  tier:
    TIER-A:
      - openai/gpt-oss-120b
      - qwen/qwen3.8-27b
    TIER-B:
      - openai/gpt-oss-20b
    TIER-D:
      - allam-2-7b
  models:
    openai/gpt-oss-120b: { max_input_tokens: 7000 }
    openai/gpt-oss-20b: { max_input_tokens: 7000 }
    qwen/qwen3.8-27b: { max_input_tokens: 7000, max_output_tokens: 16384 }
    # allam-2-7b has a 4096 combined window, so the input cap leaves room for the output.
    allam-2-7b: { max_input_tokens: 2048 }
    "whisper-*": { mode: audio_transcription, rpm: 20 }
    "*orpheus*": { mode: audio_speech, rpm: 10, tpm: 1200 }

kilo:
  api_key: env:KILO_API_KEY
  # Free models: 200 requests per IP per hour, https://kilo.ai/docs/gateway/usage-and-billing
  hourly_requests: 200
  exclude:
    - "*content-safety*"
    - "!*:free"
  tier:
    TIER-A:
      - "glm-5*"
      - "inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash*"
      - "nvidia/nemotron-3-super-*"
      - "nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-*"
      - "poolside/laguna-s-*"
      - "qwen/qwen3.8-27b*"
      - "stepfun/step-3.7-flash*"
      - "thinkingmachines/inkling*"
    TIER-B:
      - "*" # every other model; a more specific pattern wins
    TIER-D:
      - "liquid/lfm-2.5-2.6b*"

mistral:
  api_key: env:MISTRAL_API_KEY
  tier:
    TIER-A:
      - "mistral-medium-*"
    TIER-B:
      - "mistral-small-2*"
    TIER-C:
      - "mistral-large-*"
      - "codestral*"
      - "*leanstral*"
      - "ministral-14b-*"
      - "voxtral-small-*"
    TIER-D:
      - "ministral-8b-*"
      - "ministral-3b-*"
  models:
    "voxtral-mini*": { mode: audio_transcription }
    "voxtral*-tts*": { mode: audio_speech } # the TTS models speak, they do not transcribe
    "*embed*": { mode: embedding }

openrouter:
  api_key: env:OPENROUTER_API_KEY
  exclude:
    - "*content-safety*"
    - recraft/* # image generation needs a credit balance, also for the :free ids
    - "!*:free"
  tier:
    TIER-A:
      - "inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash*"
      - "nvidia/nemotron-3-super-*"
      - "nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-*"
      - "poolside/laguna-s-*"
      - "qwen/qwen3.8-27b*"
      - "stepfun/step-3.7-flash*"
      - "thinkingmachines/inkling*"
    TIER-B:
      - "*" # every other model; a more specific pattern wins
    TIER-D:
      - "liquid/lfm-2.5-2.6b*"

z-ai:
  api_key: env:ZAI_API_KEY
  exclude:
    - "*"
  tier:
    TIER-B:
      - glm-4.5-flash
      - glm-4.7-flash
    TIER-D:
      - glm-4.6v-flash
  models:
    glm-4.5-flash: { max_input_tokens: 131072, max_output_tokens: 98304, rpm: 60, tpm: 8000 }
    glm-4.6v-flash: { max_input_tokens: 131072, max_output_tokens: 98304, rpm: 60, tpm: 8000 }
    glm-4.7-flash: { max_input_tokens: 131072, max_output_tokens: 131072, rpm: 60, tpm: 8000 }

api_key: env:OPENROUTER_API_KEY
tier:
  TIER-A:
    - "z-ai/glm-5.3-flash"
models:
  z-ai/glm-5.3-flash:
    # A short wait: flash answers fast or not at all.
    timeout: 15
    rpm: 15000
    tpm: 1200000
    max_input_tokens: 1310720
    max_output_tokens: 131072
    reasoning_effort: low
    # OpenRouter tries the endpoints with the cheapest output price first.
    hooks:
      - on-catalog: hooks/or_cheapest_output.py
      - on-upstream: hooks/or_cheapest_output.py
    # Direct requests only: this model stays out of each pool and daedalus/auto.
    pool: false

api_key: env:POLLINATIONS_API_KEY
# The order of Cloudflare: no image model has order 1, so both share daedalus/photos.
order: 2
# Each other model spends Pollen faster, and most need a paid balance.
exclude:
  - "*"
# Not in free.yml: the Pollen does not refill, see https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/issues/11580
# The Pollen for each image.
models:
  lykon/dreamshaper-8-lcm: { mode: image_generation, rpm: 300 } # 0.0001
  black-forest-labs/flux.1-schnell: { mode: image_generation, rpm: 60 } # 0.002
  tongyi-mai/z-image-turbo: { mode: image_generation, rpm: 60 } # 0.004
  # Image input: edits with up to 10 input images.
  black-forest-labs/flux.2-klein-4b: { mode: image_generation, rpm: 60, supports_vision: true } # 0.005

settings.text:
# Router settings. Each key is optional. A missing key uses the built-in default.
# This file holds the changes from the defaults only. docs/configuration.md lists each key,
# its default and its use.
# DAEDALUS_HOST and DAEDALUS_PORT set the address, for example in compose.yml.
# HEADROOM_URL turns on message compression through a Headroom sidecar.
# `headroom: false` in a provider block or a model entry turns it off for that scope.
hooks:
  # The files sit in the folder of `dir` under config, and a GitHub source fills it. See docs/hooks.md.
  # The request-level hook files of the config folder, in list order. An empty list: no hook.
  # on-request sets the key of the turn. The shipped file applies the Open WebUI try-again rule.
  on-request: [hooks/owui_auto_reasoning_effort.py]
  # on-prompt sets the reasoning level of a chat request. The shipped file reads the tier of the
  # message and steps the level 1 up for a try again, for an Open WebUI client.
  on-prompt: [hooks/owui_auto_reasoning_effort.py]
  # on-chunk sees each streamed chunk of a chat request. The shipped file writes the served model
  # line.
  on-chunk: [hooks/served_model.py]
